subject: Hosted quickstart & sandbox endpoints — follow-up and access plan
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acmesys.com>, AcmeSys Team <team@acmesys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 15:08:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted quickstart & sandbox endpoints — follow-up and access plan

Hi Lina — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our demo and the recommended path for an initial hosted evaluation: 

- Goal: Validate inference latency and cost profile for search/assistant workload (avg. 150 tokens per request, peak 30 rps).
- Recommended eval mode: Hosted API quickstart (fastest path to results, no infra ops) — includes a sandbox endpoint, 3-day test credits, and a dedicated trial rate policy.

What we can provide immediately: 
- Sandbox endpoint (staging) details and an API key with scoped rate caps.
- A short quickstart packet (attached) with curl examples, sample payloads, and KV/prefix cache tips.
- A live 30–45m technical walk-through with our Solutions Engineer (Jordan) if you want to run initial traffic together.

Specific asks from our side to configure the trial: 
1) Confirm whether you need EU data residency for logs/metrics (hosted supports region pinning).
2) Expected peak concurrency during the trial (helps us size rate caps).
3) Any IP allowlist or SSO requirement to attach to the sandbox key.

Proposed next steps: 
- If you agree, I’ll spin up the sandbox key and share endpoints + sample CURLs by EOD Monday.
- Jordan can join a quickstart session Tuesday or Wednesday to walk through traffic replay and explain rate behavior.

Attachments: redwood_hosted_quickstart.pdf (quickstart guide), sandbox-endpoints.txt (endpoint list).

Thanks — looking forward to getting you running.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0148
Redwood Inference

From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmesys.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart & sandbox endpoints — follow-up and access plan

Ben — thanks for the recap and the clear options. A couple of quick clarifications before we kick off the hosted trial:

- Data residency: AcmeSys needs EU residency (logs and metrics), but production will likely be US. Is the hosted sandbox able to pin to eu-central?
- Rate caps: our internal API gateway can burst, but we need a steady-state expected peak of ~20 rps and a short burst to 45 rps for 30s. Will the trial key support that profile?
- SSO: procurement will want the sandbox access to be SSO-bound for audit. We can share SAML metadata if that’s supported in the trial.

Also looping procurement on timeline — procurement, please advise on standard trial paperwork or PO requirements.

Thanks,
Lina Park
CTO, AcmeSys
Lina.Park@acmesys.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acmesys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart & sandbox endpoints — follow-up and access plan

Lina — great questions. Quick answers inline and a proposed sandbox config.

- Data residency: yes — we can provision the sandbox in eu-central (logs + metrics) for the duration of the trial. Production pinning is separate; we’ll document migration steps in the playbook.

- Rate caps: we can map your steady-state and burst profile to a trial rate policy. Proposed config for the sandbox key:
  * steady: 25 rps (per-key smoothing)
  * burst window: allow 45 rps for 60s with token bucket refill — will handle your 30s bursts safely
  * concurrent streams: up to 10 streaming responses concurrently

- SSO: we support SAML-based binding for sandbox keys. For the trial, we can also provide user-scoped API keys tied to email, but if procurement requires SSO for audit we’ll accept the SAML metadata and set up an IdP binding for the sandbox environment. Jordan — can you coordinate the SAML checklist with Lina?

Attached: sandbox-endpoints.txt with the eu-central staging URL, and a short SSO checklist stub (sso-integration-checklist.md). Below is a sample curl to hit the sandbox (replace <SANDBOX_KEY>):

curl -X POST https://eu.staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <SANDBOX_KEY>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2.1-mini","input":"Summarize customer feedback"}'

If that config looks good, I’ll: 
- Create the sandbox key and share it with SSO binding instructions and the endpoint list by EOD.
- Schedule a 30m session with Jordan for Tuesday 11/3 or Wednesday 11/4 to run a traffic replay.

Ben

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted quickstart & sandbox endpoints — follow-up and access plan

Lina — looping in with the technical next steps. I can run the quickstart session on Tuesday 11/3 at 2:00 PM PST (I have a slot). Agenda for the 30m session:

- 5m: confirm traffic profile and SSO requirement
- 10m: live traffic replay to eu staging endpoint + observe latency/throughput
- 10m: review caching and batching knobs (prefix/KV), and how to tune for cost vs latency
- 5m: confirm success criteria and next steps for Dedicated evaluation if needed

Pre-work for the session: 
- Ben: please provision the sandbox key with the proposed rate cap (steady 25 rps, burst 45 rps / 60s).
- Lina: share SAML metadata if procurement wants SSO binding; otherwise we’ll create user-scoped keys and send guidance.
- Team: I’ll prepare a simple Postman collection and a short script to replay 1k requests with your sample payload so we can observe 95th/99th p99 latencies.

Attachment: sandbox-endpoints.txt (included) and a small utility script (referenced link). If that time doesn’t work, I can do Wednesday 11/4 at 10:00 AM PST.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0202
